name: io.github.bryanjbelanger/desktop-hypervisor-mcp
description: VirtualBox and VMware Fusion/Workstation behind one provider-neutral MCP tool surface.

environmentVariables.name: HV_GUEST_USER
environmentVariables.description: Username for in-guest operations (exec, script, file copy). Omit if guest operations are not needed.

environmentVariables.name: HV_GUEST_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for in-guest operations. Read from the server environment, never accepted as a tool parameter.

environmentVariables.name: HV_IMAGE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Cache directory for downloaded OS images. Defaults to ~/.hypervisor-images.
